name: Raga Finance
rootCause: Raga Finance suffered a reported approximately $18,500 exploit on Hyperliquid L1 on 2025-11-22. Publicly available evidence classifies the incident as a protocol logic failure, but no exploit transaction, vulnerable contract revision, or technical postmortem has been released. Public incident catalogues classify the Raga Finance event as a protocol logic failure affecting its Hyperliquid deployment. The specific vulnerable function, exploit sequence, and broken accounting or authorization invariant have not been publicly disclosed as of 2026-09-19.
